title: Tall white deep spacecraft schedules and the five-year run from the home planet
summary: Charles Hall tells of Tall white deep spacecraft schedules and the five-year run from the home planet, about 1965-1967 at Indian Springs Valley, Nevada, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The longest schedule I saw was craft that take five years. And those craft with a fiveyear schedule, I was told, were coming directly from their home planet.

plain: Charles Hall, a man who says he spent three years among tall, pale beings he calls the Tall Whites near Area 51, a secret Air Force base in Nevada, says he saw their flight schedules while stationed in Indian Springs Valley between 1965 and 1967. He says the longest schedule he saw was for craft that took five years, and he was told those craft came straight from the beings' home planet. If true, it would mean regular traffic between Earth and another world.
